title: Deeper/broader open-source codec, application, and geometry-route research
mode: primary-source web research and plan refinement
scope: Refresh open-source DWG/DXF codec coverage and distinguish parser, writer, application, carrier, and kernel evidence
Evaluate the ACadRust/opencadcodec, OpenCADStudio, and OpenCADKernel lineage and its independence limits
Refine implementation-ready optional peer routing without increasing fast-loop validation cost

method.kind: Read current primary project documentation, source manifests/tests, and issue reports; reconcile with the local plan
method.limitations: Mutable upstream pages were read on 2026-10-18 and were not independently executed. Project feature matrices, generated self-roundtrip tests, issue narratives, and release notes are discovery evidence only. No external files were downloaded, no peer/native route was run, and no semantic support claim is asserted. Existing unrelated worktree changes were preserved.

sources.observed: The separately implemented C DWG/DXF codec remains a broad structural comparison route; the documented fuzz and sanitizer workflows describe assurance methods but do not establish semantic correctness.

sources.revision: Mutable master and issue pages reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The project documents separate DWG/DXF reader and writer paths, version-dependent capabilities, and reader notification callbacks. Active issue reports are useful for identifying edge-case families but do not establish the same behavior in libdxfrw.

sources.revision: Mutable main pages reviewed 2026-10-18; manifest declares ACadRust 0.6.5
sources.observed: The crate declares ASCII/binary DXF and binary DWG reading/writing. Tests include generated ACIS-carrier envelopes and same-codec readback, which establish local route invariants but not independent producer validity or shape semantics. OpenCADStudio issue #249 reported structured XDATA loss and was later closed as fixed; it highlights version-dependent XDATA encoding but is not an active peer defect. The surrounding ecosystem imports package acadrust from the opencadcodec repository.

sources.revision: Mutable main/release and issue pages reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The current manifest pins package acadrust from the opencadcodec repository at revision 5d4f11a and opencadkernel at revision a60f18f. The application documents native DWG/DXF workflows across desktop platforms and headless audit/save_verified operations that reopen output, compare semantic manifests, report losses, and hash output. It is an optional application route, not another independent codec vote. Issue #1078 is a maintainer-reported incident and resolution, not a libdxfrw result; issue #249 is a peer-reported XDATA loss later marked fixed.

sources.revision: Mutable main/manifest reviewed 2026-10-18; package declares version 0.1.0
sources.observed: The project describes an early independent geometry kernel and an optional ACIS bridge that depends on opencadcodec. It is a watchlist candidate for a future non-OCCT kernel observation, but the public description does not establish a mature supported SAT/SAB profile or qualified complete-body semantics.

The FreeCAD add-on contains a distinct SAT parser/shape-construction route, but its documentation lists unsupported geometric cases and it does not decode DWG/AcDs ownership. FreeCAD and the importer route share the OCCT geometry kernel.

The project labels itself experimental, supports selected SAT/SAB profiles and geometry, preserves some unknown records, and converts supported bodies into CadQuery/OpenCascade. It is a bare-stream parser/converter route, not a DWG/AcDs reader or independent kernel from OCCT-based FreeCAD.
ezdxf, GDAL, and FreeCAD answer distinct DXF syntax, projected-geometry, raw-carrier, conversion, and native-consumer questions; they are not interchangeable whole-file fidelity oracles.

assessment.planImpact: Adds evidence-lineage and route-selection detail only. ACadRust/opencadcodec, OpenCADStudio, and OpenCADKernel are one correlated ecosystem for codec evidence; OpenCADStudio is an optional application route, and OpenCADKernel is only a future watchlist candidate. ACadSharp and LibreDWG remain optional question-specific codec comparators. ACIS alternatives remain profile-limited and separated from DWG/AcDs linkage and native acceptance. No required gate or per-slice work was added.

implementationReadyChecks: Select one peer for one named operation only after matching input/output format, version, direction, feature family, and independently justified expected values.

At a composed checkpoint, capture input/output hashes; exact source/package/build/features; operating system, converter, codec and kernel; diagnostics/recovery; stable handle/type/owner inventory; raw payload hashes; and per-record loss disposition.

Treat same-codec reopen and application save_verified manifests as loss-detection/self-consistency evidence, not independent semantic evidence. Pair them with literal/source-derived expectations or a distinct implementation.
For ACIS, independently gate carrier bytes, owner/key association, parser/profile acceptance, complete-body geometry/validity/measures, and native application acceptance.

Keep ordinary slices on strict touched-target builds, focused generated/in-memory selectors, compatibility checks where applicable, and the owning CTest; external peer/native/sanitizer routes remain composed milestone checks.

If a peer or native route is absent or profile-incompatible, record NOT_RUN or NOT_APPLICABLE and proceed to the next local slice; do not create an external blocker or add downloaded/committed DWG/DXF fixtures.
